title: This Snake Has Fangs Two Inches Long, Longest of Any Venomous Snake

scenes.text: This snake has the longest fangs of any venomous snake.
scenes.keywords: gaboon viper snake head close up

scenes.text: The Gaboon viper's fangs grow up to two inches long. A single bite can deliver more than a teaspoon of venom.
It weighs up to 25 pounds, the heaviest venomous snake in Africa.
It's one of the fastest-striking snakes alive. It lies perfectly still, then hits from any angle.
And it hangs on to its prey instead of letting go, like most vipers.
Longest fangs of any venomous snake. Two full inches.

description:
The Gaboon viper has the longest fangs of any venomous snake, up to two inches (5 cm).
It is also the heaviest venomous snake in Africa, a fast-striking ambush hunter whose bite can deliver 5 to 7 millilitres of venom.
Which animal would you least want to meet in the wild?
first_comment: Bonus: despite the fangs, the Gaboon viper is famously calm and rarely bites unless it is severely provoked. Which would scare you more, the fangs or the weight?
